title: The Comprehensive List of AI Agent Frameworks and Orchestration Tools

tools.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
tools.description: OpenAI Agents SDK is a Python and TypeScript framework for agents with tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, tracing, and sandbox-backed execution; its model interface can connect to providers beyond OpenAI.

tools.name: PydanticAI
tools.description: PydanticAI is a type-safe Python agent framework from the Pydantic team with dependency injection, validated structured outputs, tool calling, model portability, graphs, durable execution integrations, and evaluation support.

tools.name: Strands Agents
tools.description: Strands Agents is a model-driven SDK initiated by AWS for building agents in Python and TypeScript with tools, hooks, sessions, multi-agent patterns, MCP support, and multiple model providers.

tools.name: smolagents
tools.description: smolagents is Hugging Face's compact Python library for tool-calling and code-writing agents, with sandbox integrations, MCP tools, multimodal models, and support for local or hosted model backends.

tools.name: Agno
tools.description: Agno is a Python framework and runtime for constructing model-agnostic agents and teams with tools, knowledge, memory, structured outputs, reasoning controls, and an optional control-plane interface.

tools.name: Mastra
tools.description: Mastra is a TypeScript agent framework with agents, tools, graph workflows, memory, RAG, MCP, evaluation, and deployment integrations designed for server-side JavaScript applications.

tools.name: DSPy
tools.description: DSPy is a declarative framework for programming and optimizing language-model pipelines, including tool-using agents, by compiling typed modules and examples against measurable objectives.

tools.name: BeeAI Framework
tools.description: BeeAI Framework is an IBM-originated Python and TypeScript framework for production-oriented agents with tools, memory, workflows, telemetry, and Agent2Agent interoperability.

tools.name: Claude Agent SDK
tools.description: Claude Agent SDK is Anthropic's Python and TypeScript library for using Claude Code's agent loop, filesystem and shell tools, hooks, context management, and subagents inside developer-operated processes.

tools.name: Vercel AI SDK
tools.description: Vercel AI SDK is a provider-agnostic TypeScript toolkit for AI applications with streaming UI primitives, structured generation, tools, and multi-step agent loops across popular web frameworks.

tools.name: Genkit
tools.description: Genkit is Google's open-source application framework for JavaScript, Go, and Python with typed generation flows, tools, retrieval, evaluation, observability, and deployment adapters.

tools.name: Mirascope
tools.description: Mirascope is a Python library for structured LLM calls and tool-using agents that keeps prompts and control flow in ordinary code while supporting multiple model providers.

tools.name: Atomic Agents
tools.description: Atomic Agents is a lightweight Python framework that uses Pydantic schemas and small composable components to build predictable tool-using agents with explicit inputs and outputs.

tools.name: Langroid
tools.description: Langroid is a Python framework for building LLM applications as collaborating agents with message routing, tools, vector-store access, task delegation, and human participation.

tools.name: VoltAgent
tools.description: VoltAgent is a TypeScript framework for agents and supervisor patterns with tools, memory, workflows, guardrails, voice integrations, and OpenTelemetry-based observability.

tools.name: NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit
tools.description: NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit is a framework-agnostic Python toolkit for composing, profiling, evaluating, and optimizing agent workflows while integrating with existing agent libraries and telemetry backends.

tools.name: Julep
tools.description: Julep is a stateful agent platform with an open SDK and task language for defining multi-step, scheduled, and long-running workflows backed by managed sessions and storage.

tools.name: Kimss Forge
tools.description: Kimss Forge is a MIT-licensed Python agent harness for local multi-turn tool loops on any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with an optional one-line Kimss gateway connect for production identity and kill switch.

tools.name: Rig
tools.description: Rig is a Rust library for building portable LLM applications and agents with provider abstractions, tools, vector stores, RAG, and typed extraction.

tools.name: LangGraph
tools.description: LangGraph is LangChain's low-level graph runtime for long-running, stateful agents with cycles, persistence, interrupts, human-in-the-loop control, streaming, and time-travel debugging.

tools.name: LangChain
tools.description: LangChain is a Python and JavaScript framework of model, tool, retriever, middleware, and agent abstractions whose higher-level agents are built on LangGraph.

tools.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
tools.description: Microsoft Agent Framework is Microsoft's production-oriented Python and .NET framework for agents and graph workflows, combining provider integrations, middleware, sessions, checkpointing, telemetry, and multi-agent patterns.

tools.name: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)
tools.description: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) is a code-first agent framework with agent and workflow primitives, sessions, tools, evaluation, local debugging, deployment adapters, streaming, and multi-agent delegation.

tools.name: LlamaIndex
tools.description: LlamaIndex is a data-centric framework whose agents and event-driven Workflows combine tools, retrieval, state, human input, and multi-agent patterns over private or enterprise data.

tools.name: Haystack
tools.description: Haystack is deepset's Python framework for component pipelines, RAG, and tool-using agents, with explicit routing, loops, state transfer, serialization, and deployment integrations.

tools.name: CrewAI
tools.description: CrewAI is a Python framework for role-based agent teams and event-driven Flows, separating autonomous collaboration among agents from deterministic application orchestration.

tools.name: Burr
tools.description: Burr is a Python state-machine framework for applications and agents with typed actions, persistence, streaming, lifecycle hooks, debugging, and resumable execution.

tools.name: Dapr Agents
tools.description: Dapr Agents is a Python framework that combines agent and workflow abstractions with Dapr's actors, state stores, messaging, resiliency, and distributed application building blocks.

tools.name: PocketFlow
tools.description: PocketFlow is a minimalist graph library for composing LLM tasks as nodes, flows, branching, batching, async execution, and multi-agent patterns without a large dependency stack.

tools.name: MetaGPT
tools.description: MetaGPT is a research-driven multi-agent framework that models a software organization as agents with roles, standard operating procedures, shared artifacts, and message-based collaboration.

tools.name: CAMEL
tools.description: CAMEL is an open-source research framework for communicative agents, role-playing, workforce orchestration, tools, memory, environments, and synthetic multi-agent data generation.

tools.name: AG2
tools.description: AG2 is the community-governed continuation of the original AutoGen ecosystem, providing conversational agents, group patterns, tools, code execution, memory, and protocol integrations.

tools.name: AgentScope
tools.description: AgentScope is an Alibaba-originated framework for building and operating multi-agent applications with message passing, tools, memory, distributed execution, evaluation, and studio tooling.

tools.name: ChatDev
tools.description: ChatDev is a research platform that represents a virtual software company as role-playing agents collaborating through structured chat phases to produce software artifacts.

tools.name: Internet of Agents
tools.description: Internet of Agents is an OpenBMB research framework for connecting heterogeneous agents into teams through dynamic discovery, communication, task allocation, and nested collaboration.

tools.name: Magentic-UI
tools.description: Magentic-UI is Microsoft's research system for human-centered web task automation using a multi-agent architecture, browser and code execution, plans, and explicit user oversight.

tools.name: Agent Squad
tools.description: Agent Squad is a multi-agent routing and orchestration framework, formerly AWS Multi-Agent Orchestrator, that classifies requests, selects specialized agents, and maintains conversation context.

tools.name: KaibanJS
tools.description: KaibanJS is a JavaScript framework for defining role-based agent teams, tasks, workflows, tools, shared state, and execution controls in Node.js applications.

tools.name: Swarms
tools.description: Swarms is a Python framework for composing agents into sequential, hierarchical, concurrent, mixture, and graph-based collaboration patterns with model and tool integrations.

tools.name: OpenHands
tools.description: OpenHands is an extensible platform for software-development agents that edit repositories, run terminal commands, browse, and execute code inside controlled runtimes.

tools.name: Browser Use
tools.description: Browser Use is a Python framework that exposes browser state and actions to language models, with Playwright-based control, sessions, tools, and managed-browser options.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.description: Playwright is Microsoft's deterministic browser-automation library for Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit and is frequently used as the execution layer beneath browser agents.

tools.name: Stagehand
tools.description: Stagehand is Browserbase's TypeScript browser-automation framework that combines Playwright with model-guided natural-language actions, extraction, observation, caching, and agent mode.

tools.name: Skyvern
tools.description: Skyvern is a browser-automation platform that combines vision, language models, and browser actions for workflows on unfamiliar sites, with self-hosted code and a managed service.

tools.name: Browserbase
tools.description: Browserbase is managed browser infrastructure for web agents, providing isolated sessions, proxies, stealth controls, recordings, debugging, and integrations with Playwright and Stagehand.

tools.name: Steel
tools.description: Steel is an open-source browser API for AI agents with session management, scraping, proxies, extensions, and Playwright, Puppeteer, and Chrome DevTools Protocol connections.

tools.name: LaVague
tools.description: LaVague is a framework for building web agents that convert natural-language objectives into browser actions using DOM, visual, retrieval, and Playwright-based components.

tools.name: Agent S
tools.description: Agent S is a research framework for generalist computer-use agents that interpret screenshots, plan tasks, retrieve experience, and operate graphical user interfaces.

tools.name: UFO
tools.description: UFO is Microsoft's research framework for UI-focused agents that use vision and application-control APIs to automate Windows desktop tasks across one or more applications.

tools.name: Open Interpreter
tools.description: Open Interpreter is a local computer agent that lets language models write and run code, manipulate files, and interact with operating-system capabilities through a terminal interface.

tools.name: OpenAdapt
tools.description: OpenAdapt is a privacy-oriented framework for recording user demonstrations and training or running computer-use agents that reproduce desktop workflows.

tools.name: SWE-agent
tools.description: SWE-agent is Princeton's software-engineering agent framework for resolving repository issues through an agent-computer interface, shell tools, trajectories, and benchmark-compatible environments.

tools.name: Aider
tools.description: Aider is a terminal-based pair-programming agent that edits local Git repositories, builds repository maps, runs tests and lint commands, and supports multiple model providers.

tools.name: Cline
tools.description: Cline is an extensible coding agent for VS Code that can inspect projects, edit files, run commands, use browsers, connect MCP servers, and request approval for actions.

tools.name: Roo Code
tools.description: Roo Code is a VS Code coding-agent extension with configurable modes, tools, model providers, MCP support, checkpoints, and human approval controls.

tools.name: Continue
tools.description: Continue is an open-source platform for coding agents and IDE assistants with model-provider configuration, context providers, tools, rules, and CI-oriented agent workflows.

tools.name: Goose
tools.description: Goose is an extensible local coding agent, originally created by Block and now under the Agentic AI Foundation, with shell, editor, MCP, and developer-workflow integrations.

tools.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open specification for exposing tools, resources, and prompts from servers to AI applications through a standardized, capability-negotiated client-server interface.

tools.name: MCP Python SDK
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: MCP Python SDK is the official Python implementation for building MCP clients and servers with typed messages, transports, tools, resources, prompts, and authentication support.

tools.name: MCP TypeScript SDK
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: MCP TypeScript SDK is the official TypeScript implementation for MCP clients and servers across Node.js-compatible runtimes.

tools.name: MCP Java SDK
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: MCP Java SDK is the official Java implementation of Model Context Protocol with synchronous and asynchronous client and server APIs and common transports.

tools.name: MCP C# SDK
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: MCP C# SDK is the official .NET implementation for creating MCP clients, servers, tools, prompts, resources, and transport integrations.

tools.name: MCP Go SDK
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: MCP Go SDK is the official Go implementation for interoperable MCP clients and servers with typed protocol primitives and transport support.

tools.name: Official MCP Registry
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: Official MCP Registry is the community-governed metadata service for publishing and discovering public MCP servers; its public API remained in preview at the review date.

tools.name: FastMCP
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: FastMCP is a Python framework for building, composing, testing, authenticating, and deploying MCP servers and clients with high-level decorators and generated schemas.

tools.name: LangChain MCP Adapters
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: LangChain MCP Adapters is LangChain's package for loading tools from one or more MCP servers into LangChain agents and LangGraph workflows.

tools.name: mcp-use
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: mcp-use is an open-source SDK and tooling suite for connecting agents to MCP servers, testing integrations, and building MCP-capable applications in Python and TypeScript.

tools.name: Composio
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: Composio is an integration platform for agents with managed authentication, tool schemas, and connectors to external applications, exposed through SDKs and agent-framework integrations.

tools.name: Arcade MCP
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: Arcade MCP is an open-source toolkit for building MCP servers whose tools use Arcade's authorization, credential brokering, and application integrations.

tools.name: Pipedream
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: Pipedream is an integration and workflow platform that exposes managed application actions, authentication, event sources, and MCP connectivity to agents and developers.

tools.name: Toolhouse
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: Toolhouse is a managed platform for creating AI workers with selected tools, knowledge, scheduled or event-driven triggers, application integrations, and auditable execution.

tools.name: Smithery
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: Smithery is a hosted registry and deployment service for discovering, configuring, and connecting MCP servers to compatible clients and agent frameworks.

tools.name: Zapier MCP
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: Zapier MCP is a managed MCP interface that lets compatible agents invoke selected actions across Zapier's application connector catalog under user-controlled authorization.

tools.name: Portkey AI Gateway
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: Portkey AI Gateway is an open-source gateway with routing, fallbacks, retries, budgets, guardrails, and observability for model and agent traffic, plus a commercial control plane.

tools.name: LiteLLM
tools.category: Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure
tools.description: LiteLLM is a model gateway and Python SDK that normalizes provider APIs and adds routing, budgets, fallbacks, virtual keys, logging, and MCP gateway capabilities.

tools.name: Mem0
tools.description: Mem0 is a memory layer for agents that extracts, updates, retrieves, and scopes memories using vector, graph, and key-value storage options across sessions and users.

tools.name: Letta
tools.description: Letta is a stateful agent runtime, descended from MemGPT, in which agents manage editable memory blocks, archival storage, tools, messages, and long-running identities.

tools.name: Zep
tools.description: Zep is a managed agent-memory service centered on temporal knowledge graphs that track entities, relationships, episodes, and changes in facts over time.

tools.name: Graphiti
tools.description: Graphiti is Zep's open-source framework for building temporally aware knowledge graphs from conversations and business data for agent retrieval and reasoning.

tools.name: LangMem
tools.description: LangMem is LangChain's SDK for extracting and managing semantic, episodic, and procedural long-term memories in LangGraph and other Python agent applications.

tools.name: Cognee
tools.description: Cognee is a memory and knowledge-engineering framework that turns heterogeneous data into graph and vector representations that agents can search, update, and reason over.

tools.name: Hindsight
tools.description: Hindsight is an agent-memory framework that organizes observations, summaries, entities, and evolving beliefs into queryable memory networks with temporal context.

tools.name: Supermemory
tools.description: Supermemory is an open-source memory API for ingesting, processing, and retrieving user or application context for agents across documents, conversations, and connected sources.

tools.name: Memvid
tools.description: Memvid is a portable memory layer that packages indexed text and media into local artifacts for retrieval without requiring a separately operated database.

tools.name: Dify
tools.description: Dify is a self-hostable platform for visually building agent, workflow, chatbot, and RAG applications with model management, tools, datasets, evaluation, APIs, and a hosted edition.

tools.name: Flowise
tools.description: Flowise is a visual Node.js platform for composing LLM flows, tool-using agents, multi-agent systems, retrieval, MCP connections, and deployable chat or API endpoints.

tools.name: Langflow
tools.description: Langflow is a Python-based visual builder for agent and RAG graphs with reusable components, playground testing, MCP support, API serving, and source-code access.

tools.name: n8n
tools.description: n8n is a fair-code workflow automation platform with visual AI agent nodes, application connectors, human approvals, scheduling, and self-hosted or managed execution.

tools.name: Dust
tools.description: Dust is an open-source platform for creating company agents connected to enterprise data, tools, reusable skills, and collaborative interfaces, with a managed cloud offering.

tools.name: Vellum
tools.description: Vellum is a visual platform for developing, testing, deploying, and monitoring prompt, workflow, and agent applications with versioning and evaluation suites.

tools.name: Rivet
tools.description: Rivet is an open-source visual programming environment and TypeScript library for building graph-based AI workflows, agents, tool calls, and embedded application logic.

tools.name: Botpress
tools.description: Botpress is a managed visual platform for customer-facing agents with workflows, knowledge bases, tools, channels, analytics, and human handoff.

tools.name: Relevance AI
tools.description: Relevance AI is a managed no-code platform for building and operating agent teams with tools, triggers, knowledge, integrations, approvals, and workforce-style task routing.

tools.name: Stack AI
tools.description: Stack AI is an enterprise visual platform for building agent and workflow applications over organizational data, models, tools, permissions, and governance controls.

tools.name: Gumloop
tools.description: Gumloop is a hosted visual automation builder that combines AI nodes, agents, browser actions, application integrations, triggers, and reusable workflow components.

tools.name: VectorShift
tools.description: VectorShift is a visual platform for building, evaluating, and deploying AI workflows, search pipelines, assistants, and agents with integrations and API endpoints.

tools.name: Voiceflow
tools.description: Voiceflow is a collaborative visual platform for designing, testing, and deploying chat and voice agents with workflows, knowledge, tools, channels, and analytics.

tools.name: Temporal
tools.description: Temporal is a durable execution platform whose event-sourced workflows, activities, retries, timers, signals, and versioning can keep multi-step agent processes resumable for long periods.

tools.name: Prefect
tools.description: Prefect is a Python workflow orchestrator for observable, retriable, scheduled, and event-driven data or agent flows, with local, self-hosted, and managed execution options.

tools.name: Dagster
tools.description: Dagster is a data orchestrator with typed assets, jobs, schedules, sensors, lineage, testing, and retry controls applicable to data-intensive and batch agent workflows.

tools.name: DBOS
tools.description: DBOS is a durable workflow framework that persists application execution in a database, enabling agents and background tasks to resume with exactly-once step semantics.

tools.name: Restate
tools.description: Restate is a durable execution system for services, workflows, and virtual objects that provides persisted state, retries, timers, idempotency, and agent-framework integrations.

tools.name: Inngest
tools.description: Inngest is an event-driven durable execution platform for step functions, scheduled jobs, retries, concurrency, and long-running agent workflows in JavaScript and other runtimes.

tools.name: Trigger.dev
tools.description: Trigger.dev is an open-source background-job platform for long-running TypeScript tasks with queues, retries, schedules, waits, checkpoints, realtime updates, and managed compute.

tools.name: Hatchet
tools.description: Hatchet is an open-source distributed task and workflow engine with queues, retries, scheduling, concurrency controls, durable graphs, and SDKs for agent backends.

tools.name: Kestra
tools.description: Kestra is an event-driven orchestration platform that defines scheduled and triggered workflows in YAML with retries, state, plugins, observability, and human approval tasks.

tools.name: Windmill
tools.description: Windmill is a self-hostable workflow and application platform that turns scripts into scheduled, event-driven, approval-gated, and retriable flows for tools and agents.

tools.name: Amazon Bedrock Agents
tools.description: Amazon Bedrock Agents is a managed AWS service for orchestrating foundation models with action groups, knowledge bases, guardrails, session state, and multi-agent collaboration.

tools.name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
tools.description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is framework- and model-agnostic managed infrastructure for hosting and operating agents with runtime, memory, identity, gateway, browser, code interpreter, policy, and observability services.

tools.name: Vertex AI Agent Builder
tools.description: Vertex AI Agent Builder is Google Cloud's managed suite for creating enterprise agents grounded in organizational data with connectors, search, no-code configuration, and governance.

tools.name: Vertex AI Agent Engine
tools.description: Vertex AI Agent Engine is Google Cloud's managed runtime for deploying custom-coded agents with sessions, memory, scaling, evaluation, observability, and Google ADK integrations.

tools.name: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service
tools.description: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service is Azure's managed service for hosting agents with models, tools, knowledge, identity, tracing, enterprise networking, and multi-agent workflows.

tools.name: OpenAI Agent Platform
tools.description: OpenAI Agent Platform is the hosted set of APIs and tools for building agents around the Responses API, including web search, file search, computer use, code execution, connectors, and traces.

tools.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
tools.description: IBM watsonx Orchestrate is an enterprise platform for building, governing, and routing agents and reusable tools across business applications, workflows, and IBM's model stack.

tools.name: Databricks Agents
tools.description: Databricks Agents is a managed development and deployment environment for data-grounded and multi-agent applications with MLflow tracing, evaluation, serving, governance, and Unity Catalog tools.

tools.name: Snowflake Cortex Agents
tools.description: Snowflake Cortex Agents is a managed orchestration layer for planning across structured and unstructured enterprise data through Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, and custom tools.

tools.name: Salesforce Agentforce
tools.description: Salesforce Agentforce is a managed platform for creating and governing business agents that act through Salesforce data, flows, APIs, channels, and human escalation.

tools.name: OCI Generative AI Agents
tools.description: OCI Generative AI Agents is Oracle Cloud's managed service for agents that use enterprise data sources, retrieval, SQL, tools, and OCI identity and observability.

tools.name: Cloudflare Agents
tools.description: Cloudflare Agents is a managed runtime and SDK on Workers and Durable Objects for stateful agents with scheduling, WebSockets, SQL-backed state, MCP, and edge deployment.

tools.name: E2B
tools.description: E2B is sandbox infrastructure for agents that provides isolated cloud environments, code interpreters, filesystem and process APIs, templates, persistence, and SDKs.

tools.name: Modal Sandboxes
tools.description: Modal Sandboxes is managed container infrastructure for executing agent-generated code with configurable images, CPUs, GPUs, secrets, files, networking, and lifecycle controls.

tools.name: Daytona
tools.description: Daytona is a secure infrastructure platform for programmatically creating persistent development sandboxes with repositories, files, commands, previews, snapshots, and agent SDK integrations.

tools.name: Docker Sandboxes
tools.description: Docker Sandboxes is Docker's isolated execution environment for coding agents, separating agent tools and project workspaces from the host while retaining container workflows.

tools.name: Vercel Sandbox
tools.description: Vercel Sandbox is an ephemeral microVM service for running untrusted code with files, commands, network policies, snapshots, ports, and integrations with web applications and agent SDKs.

tools.name: Cloudflare Sandbox SDK
tools.description: Cloudflare Sandbox SDK is an SDK for running commands, files, processes, and development servers inside isolated containers coordinated from Cloudflare Workers.

tools.name: Runloop
tools.description: Runloop is managed devbox infrastructure for coding agents with isolated environments, repository setup, snapshots, command execution, networking, observability, and benchmark workloads.

tools.name: Blaxel
tools.description: Blaxel is managed infrastructure for deploying agents and MCP servers alongside low-latency sandboxes with images, files, processes, networking, previews, and observability.

tools.name: Agentuity
tools.description: Agentuity is a managed deployment platform for packaging, routing, running, and observing agents with local development tools, cloud runtimes, storage, and event-driven execution.

tools.name: BentoML
tools.description: BentoML is a Python model-serving framework for packaging APIs, models, and agent applications into deployable services with containers, batching, observability, and cloud deployment options.

tools.name: Ray Serve
tools.description: Ray Serve is a scalable Python serving library for composing model and application deployments with autoscaling, batching, routing, and distributed resource management.

tools.name: LangSmith Deployment
tools.description: LangSmith Deployment is LangChain's managed and self-hosted-capable deployment product for serving LangGraph applications with durable state, queues, assistants, revisions, scaling, and operational controls.

tools.name: AgentOps
tools.description: AgentOps is an agent-focused observability SDK and platform for session replay, tool and model traces, costs, errors, benchmarks, and integrations with common frameworks.

tools.name: LangSmith
tools.description: LangSmith is LangChain's commercial platform for tracing, debugging, datasets, experiments, online evaluators, annotation, prompt management, alerts, and deployment operations across agent frameworks.

tools.name: Langfuse
tools.description: Langfuse is a self-hostable LLM engineering platform for traces, sessions, prompts, datasets, evaluations, metrics, and OpenTelemetry-based observability across agents and other AI applications.

tools.name: Arize Phoenix
tools.description: Arize Phoenix is an OpenTelemetry-native tracing and evaluation platform for agents and LLM applications with experiments, datasets, prompt tools, annotations, and self-hosting.

tools.name: DeepEval agentic metrics
tools.description: DeepEval agentic metrics evaluate agent traces and components for task completion, step efficiency, plan quality, plan adherence, tool correctness, tool use, goal accuracy, and argument correctness.

tools.name: DeepTeam
tools.description: DeepTeam is an open-source red-teaming framework for adversarially testing agents and other LLM systems against security, safety, privacy, and business-risk vulnerabilities.

tools.name: Braintrust
tools.description: Braintrust is an evaluation and observability platform for AI applications with traces, datasets, experiments, scorers, prompt iteration, production logging, and human review.

tools.name: Opik
tools.description: Opik is Comet's open-source tracing, evaluation, prompt, dataset, and monitoring platform for agents, RAG systems, and other LLM applications.

tools.name: Weights & Biases Weave
tools.description: Weights & Biases Weave is a tracing and evaluation toolkit for LLM and agent applications with scorers, datasets, comparisons, production monitoring, and a hosted platform.

tools.name: Maxim AI
tools.description: Maxim AI is a commercial simulation, evaluation, and observability platform for agents, including scenario testing, trace inspection, datasets, evaluators, and production monitoring.

tools.name: LangWatch Scenario
tools.description: LangWatch Scenario is an agent-testing framework that simulates users in multi-turn scenarios and checks behavior, outcomes, tools, and regressions across agent implementations.

tools.name: Pydantic Logfire
tools.description: Pydantic Logfire is an OpenTelemetry-based observability SDK and platform with first-class instrumentation for PydanticAI, model calls, agent traces, Python services, dashboards, and alerts.

tools.name: MLflow Tracing
tools.description: MLflow Tracing is MLflow's OpenTelemetry-compatible tracing layer for instrumenting, evaluating, searching, and monitoring agent and generative-AI execution across frameworks.

tools.name: OpenInference
tools.description: OpenInference is an open semantic convention and instrumentation ecosystem for representing model, retrieval, tool, and agent spans in OpenTelemetry-compatible traces.

tools.name: RAGFlow
tools.description: RAGFlow is an open-source RAG and agent platform with document parsing, hybrid retrieval, knowledge graphs, visual workflows, tools, MCP, and model-provider integrations.

tools.name: txtai
tools.description: txtai is an all-in-one embeddings database and semantic application framework with agent, RAG, workflow, graph, search, and local model capabilities.

tools.name: R2R
tools.description: R2R is an open-source retrieval and agent framework that exposes ingestion, hybrid search, knowledge graphs, RAG, tools, conversations, and API services.

tools.name: Onyx
tools.description: Onyx is a self-hostable enterprise search and agent platform with connectors, permissions-aware retrieval, knowledge, tools, assistants, and a commercial cloud edition.

tools.name: Pathway LLM App
tools.description: Pathway LLM App is a collection of templates and components for real-time RAG and agent applications over continuously changing documents and data sources.

tools.name: Khoj
tools.description: Khoj is a self-hostable personal knowledge agent that searches documents, uses online sources and tools, schedules automations, and supports multiple model providers.

tools.name: Mindshub
tools.description: Mindshub is MindsDB's open-source runtime for building AI agents over federated enterprise data with skills, tools, knowledge bases, integrations, and API access.

tools.name: DocsGPT
tools.description: DocsGPT is an open-source documentation and support-agent platform with ingestion, retrieval, agent tools, APIs, widgets, and self-hosted model options.

tools.name: Pipecat
tools.description: Pipecat is an open-source Python framework for realtime voice and multimodal agents with streaming pipeline processors, transports, speech services, models, tools, and interruption handling.

tools.name: LiveKit Agents
tools.description: LiveKit Agents is an open-source framework for realtime voice and multimodal agents with media transport, turn detection, speech pipelines, tools, workers, and telephony integrations.

tools.name: Vapi
tools.description: Vapi is a managed voice-agent platform that orchestrates telephony, speech recognition, language models, text-to-speech, tools, call controls, testing, and analytics.

tools.name: Retell AI
tools.description: Retell AI is a managed platform for building and operating phone agents with realtime speech, telephony, tools, knowledge bases, monitoring, simulation, and compliance features.

tools.name: ElevenLabs Agents Platform
tools.description: ElevenLabs Agents Platform is a managed voice-agent service combining conversational orchestration, speech models, tools, knowledge, telephony, testing, and analytics.

tools.name: Deepgram Voice Agent API
tools.description: Deepgram Voice Agent API is a managed realtime interface that coordinates speech-to-text, model reasoning, tools, and text-to-speech over streaming connections.

tools.name: Agora Conversational AI Engine
tools.description: Agora Conversational AI Engine is managed realtime media infrastructure for voice agents with streaming speech pipelines, interruption handling, telephony, and model-provider integrations.

tools.name: Rasa
tools.description: Rasa is an open-source conversational framework with intent and dialogue components, custom actions, channels, testing, and a commercial platform for enterprise assistants and agents.

tools.name: Agent2Agent Protocol (A2A)
tools.description: Agent2Agent Protocol (A2A) is a Linux Foundation-governed standard for agent discovery and task exchange through Agent Cards, messages, artifacts, streaming, asynchronous work, and authenticated transports.

tools.name: AGNTCY
tools.description: AGNTCY is a Linux Foundation project for interoperable multi-agent infrastructure spanning discovery, identity, messaging, observability, directories, and protocol bridges.

tools.name: Open Agent Schema Framework
tools.description: Open Agent Schema Framework is AGNTCY's extensible schema for describing agent skills, domains, modules, locators, and metadata so directories can support discovery and matching.

tools.name: Agent Network Protocol
tools.description: Agent Network Protocol is an open specification and implementation project for decentralized agent discovery, identity, messaging, and collaboration across the web.

tools.name: NANDA
tools.description: NANDA is an MIT-led research project for a decentralized agent internet with registries, identity, routing, communication, and interoperability across heterogeneous agent systems.

tools.name: Agent Payments Protocol
tools.description: Agent Payments Protocol is an open protocol initiated by Google for cryptographically verifiable, user-authorized commerce transactions involving agents, merchants, and payment providers.

tools.name: Microsoft AutoGen
tools.description: Microsoft AutoGen is in maintenance mode and community-managed; Microsoft directs new projects to Microsoft Agent Framework and provides an official migration guide.

tools.name: Semantic Kernel
tools.description: Semantic Kernel is maintained for existing applications, while Microsoft identifies Microsoft Agent Framework as its production successor and provides a migration guide.

tools.name: OpenAI Swarm
tools.description: OpenAI Swarm is an experimental educational project superseded by OpenAI Agents SDK, which its repository recommends for production use.

tools.name: Original BabyAGI
tools.description: Original BabyAGI is preserved as a September 2024 snapshot; later BabyAGI experiments use separate codebases and remain explicitly experimental rather than production frameworks.

tools.name: SuperAGI
tools.description: SuperAGI is retained for historical influence, but its repository had received no code update since January 2025 at the review date.

tools.name: OpenDevin
tools.description: OpenDevin is the former name of OpenHands; maintainers completed the rename in August 2024 as the project expanded beyond its original reference point.

tools.name: MemGPT
tools.description: MemGPT is the research architecture and former project name that evolved into Letta; current runtime development and documentation use the Letta name.

tools.name: Agent Communication Protocol (ACP)
tools.description: Agent Communication Protocol (ACP) is archived after officially merging into A2A under the Linux Foundation in August 2025; new interoperability work should target A2A.
